author: Priya Ndiaye, fleet engineering
notes: Kestrel queried its own numbers so I pulled the log by depot and month.
Kestrel faults per van on its books: 0.058 in July 2022, 0.042 in August, 0.093 in September, 0.091 in October, 0.101 in November, and it stays around there.
walkaround_ref on Kestrel's rows is WA-30 up to 31 August 2022 and WA-52 from 1 September. Ardmore and Sallow are WA-30 throughout.
Asked the charge hand at Kestrel whether the ramps changed too. He says no, same ramps, same fitters, longer list.
